contexts.text: (Such) are thrust down into the intestines, and at last into the rectum, where is the first Hell... SE 1742.
Such in Hell belong to the colon and rectum. Described.
(The better sort of the Spirits of the colon and rectum.) Described.
These are the Hells into which leads the way through the rectum intestine.
Thus does the province of the colon extend itself to Hell... as does the colon into the rectum intestine, which is the infernal tun.
Sirens... act into the lower intestines, especially into the rectum, and cause there a species of colic, and a difficulty in voiding the excrement.
